issue: Bare except clause catches all exceptions including system-level exceptions like KeyboardInterrupt and SystemExit. Should be replaced with more specific exception types like UnicodeDecodeError or ValueError
No validation that 'sender' exists in integration.metadata before accessing it. Integrations created before this feature was deployed may not have the 'sender' field, causing a KeyError at runtime
safe_urlopen call can raise various exceptions (RequestException, Timeout, RestrictedIPAddress, SuspiciousOperation) that are not handled, resulting in a 500 error instead of proper error page
get_user_info function can raise HTTPError or JSONDecodeError if GitHub API returns an error or invalid JSON, resulting in a 500 error for the user
Assignment to 'resp' is unnecessary as it is redefined before this value is used (multiple instances)
